about_the_game:
Key Features:

  • A Massive 240+ Square Mile Open World: Explore the persistent "Land of Shinobi."

  • True MMO Infrastructure: Always-online dedicated servers (Microsoft Azure), persistent player accounts, leaderboards, and stats.

  • "Flow of Battle" Combat: A fluid, overhauled system with dynamic combos, hand signs, and a rope kunai for traversal.

  • Over 70 Unique Jutsus: Master the elements, from devastating fire techniques to the Jinsoku teleportation jutsu.

  • Dynamic Weather & Sky: Rain, fog, storms, snow, and a full day/night cycle.

  • Deep Social Systems: Create clans with custom ranks, form parties, and use integrated chat.

  • Player-Driven Economy: Trade gear and scrolls with vendors and other players.

  • Dynamic World Events: The world is constantly changing with new threats and opportunities.

Forge your legend in Shinobi Unleashed, an open-world MMORPG that redefines action combat. This is not a game of tab-targeting and static abilities. This is a world of fluid motion, precise skill, and true elemental power, all built on a persistent, dedicated server network. Your journey from an unknown rookie to a Kage-level warrior begins now.

Explore the "Land of Shinobi," a massive, persistent continent spanning over 240 square miles (25x25km). This is a world of sprawling mystery and danger. From the bustling ports of coastal towns to the serene temples of hidden villages, every peak and valley holds a new challenge. Uncover the secrets of ancient mines, traverse untamed wilderness, and prove your strength in a world that is as beautiful as it is deadly.

Combat in Shinobi Unleashed is a "Flow of Battle," a fluid dance of steel and chakra. This comprehensive overhaul eliminates stiffness, giving you unparalleled freedom. Master a dynamic combo system, swing through the forests with a rope kunai, and execute precise hand signs for your techniques. Command over 70 unique jutsus: summon meteors from the heavens, encase yourself in ethereal Shingoku ribcage armor jutsu, or hunt for the fabled Jinsoku Blade to master teleportation. Your arsenal is limited only by your will.

Defeat powerful S-Rank foes and world bosses to claim legendary scrolls and gear. Your progression is limitless as you build your shinobi over time. Engage in a player-driven economy where you can sell your spoils to vendors or trade directly with other players. Hunt for rare drops, master the markets, and equip yourself with the most powerful artifacts in the land.

This is a true, persistent MMORPG. Our world is powered by a robust infrastructure of Microsoft Azure dedicated servers and a secure Player Account system. Create lasting alliances by founding your own clan and appointing trusted allies. Compete for glory on official leaderboards, track your player stats, and connect with a global community using our region selector.

The "Land of Shinobi" is not static. It breathes. A fully dynamic weather and sky system brings the world to life. Adapt to sudden rainstorms, use dense fog for an ambush, or travel by the light of a star-filled night. The world also evolves with dynamic events, like a surprise invasion of S-Rank Rogue Shinobi, ensuring your adventure is never the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X / Intel Core i7-12700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVMe SSD Required for Nanite streaming. 1440p / 60 FPS High Settings.

short_description: Forge your legend in Shinobi Unleashed, an open-world MMORPG. Experience a fluid combat system as you master over 70 devastating jutsus. Team up with friends in clans, hunt legendary foes for rare loot, and engage in a player-driven economy. Your path to becoming the ultimate shinobi awaits.
